snippet.title: 『Magical Princess』Introduction Movie【INDIE Live Expo 2026.4.25】
snippet.description:
▼Click here for the Steam store page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562120/Magical_Princess/

▼Click here for the Official X
https://x.com/magicalbakerybg

▼Click here for the Official YouTube
@magicalmagiinc 

Magical Princess is a new raising sim launching on Steam on April 28, three days after this show. Its demo earned a 97% satisfaction rate, so be sure to check the store page.

You play as a father raising his daughter from childhood through graduation. Attending classes, part-time jobs, and more—shapes her future, leading to 50+ endings. The game also features rich relationships, including 7 romance options and 170+ date events. No matter the outcome, the bond between father and daughter remains at the heart of the story.
